July 24, 2026


English River First Nation is a valued partner in Cameco's vision to power a secure energy future – and we congratulate them on the grand opening of their new band office last week. We were deeply honoured to attend this milestone event complete with a pipe ceremony, ribbon cutting, guided tour and BBQ. It’s a beautiful, modern building that will help ERFN continue to make progress for their community.
